hero.sub: Sousa Dev designs, builds, deploys and runs the systems companies depend on. Custom software, architecture and IT consulting, end to end, with direct access to the engineer building it.
hero.flowRegion: How a project runs, four steps

steps.title: Meet and analyse
steps.desc: We sit down with you, understand the problem and what it costs you today.

steps.title: Propose solutions
steps.desc: Options with trade-offs, a recommended path and a fixed quote.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: Working software on staging, reviewed with you as it grows.

steps.title: Deliver end to end
steps.desc: Deployment, hosting and ongoing management. You get one accountable partner.

services.title: Four things we focus on.
services.sub: If what you need isn't here, we'll tell you, or find someone who does it well.
services.pageSub: Four services, one accountable partner. We design and build the system, put it into production, host it and keep it running.
services.runsCopy: Every service can continue into deployment, hosting and ongoing management, with the same engineer accountable for it.

process.title: A process you can hold us to.
process.sub: Every engagement follows the same four steps. You know the deliverable and the price before we write a line, and you talk to the engineer doing the work.
process.pageSub: The same four steps on every engagement, from the first conversation to running the system in production.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.desc: We map the problem, the constraints and what success looks like in numbers.
steps.detail: We start with the problem, not a feature list. We look at how the work is done today, what it costs, which systems are already in place and what has to stay. You get a written scope and a fixed quote for the next step.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.desc: Data model, integrations, infrastructure and risks, reviewed with your team.
steps.detail: Before any feature work, we write down the data model, the integrations, the infrastructure and the risks, with the trade-offs of each option. You review it with your own people and sign off on a path.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: Regular demos on a staging environment. No surprises at the end.
steps.detail: The software goes onto a staging environment early and stays there. You see it as it grows, and change direction while changing direction is still cheap.

steps.title: Run
steps.desc: Deployment, hosting and management. Documentation and training if you'd rather take over.
steps.detail: We deploy it, host it and manage it: monitoring, updates, backups and changes. If you would rather run it yourself, you get the documentation and the handover instead.

faq.q: Who will I actually be talking to?
faq.a: Henrique Sousa, the founder and lead engineer, is in the conversation from the first call. You talk to the person doing the engineering work, not to an account manager.

faq.q: Do you work with companies outside Portugal?
faq.a: Yes. Sousa Dev is based in Ponta Delgada, Azores, and works globally. We work in English and Portuguese.

Discovery produces a written scope and a fixed quote for the work that follows, so you know the deliverable and the price before development starts. Ongoing hosting and management are quoted separately from build work.

faq.q: Can you take over a system somebody else built?
faq.a: Often, yes. It starts with a review of the code, the infrastructure and the deployment setup, after which we tell you honestly what can be kept, what needs replacing and what we would not take responsibility for.

faq.q: Do you host what you build?
faq.a: Yes. Deployment, hosting and management are part of what we do, on infrastructure chosen for the system in question. You can also take the system in-house, with documentation and a handover.

faq.q: What if we already know what we want built?
faq.a: We still write the scope down and agree it with you. It is short when the problem is already clear, and it is what protects both sides later.
Yes. The code and the infrastructure configuration are yours, in your own repositories and accounts wherever you prefer that.
Yes, on request, before you share anything confidential.

products.title: We run our own products too.
products.sub: The people who build for you also ship and operate software with real users. That's how we know what breaks.
products.pageSub: Software we build, deploy, host and manage ourselves. Same process, same accountability as client work.

about.title: Built in the Azores. Working globally.
about.p1: Sousa Dev is an engineering company founded by Henrique Sousa. Wherever you are, you get a direct relationship with the people behind your project, starting with the founder and lead engineer himself.
about.p2: No account managers, no hand-offs. The person who scopes your project is the one you call when something matters.
about.pageSub: An engineering company that stays accountable for the system after it ships.

how.title: One accountable partner
how.desc: Development, deployment, hosting and management sit with the same company, so nobody can point at somebody else when a system misbehaves.

how.title: Direct line to the engineer
how.desc: You talk to the founder and lead engineer about scope, trade-offs and problems. Nothing is relayed through a sales layer.

how.title: Written before built
how.desc: Scope, architecture and price are written down and agreed before development starts, and revisited in the open when reality changes.

how.title: Your code, your infrastructure
how.desc: The code and configuration are yours. If you want to take the system in-house, you get documentation and a handover instead of a lock-in.

about.founderCopy: Henrique founded Sousa Dev and leads its engineering work. He also builds and operates the company's own products, which is where a lot of the operational experience comes from.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.sub: How this website and our proposal form handle your data.
privacy.pending: The final privacy policy for Sousa Dev, in English and Portuguese, has not been supplied yet. The summary below describes only what this website itself does today and is not a substitute for that policy.

sections.title: What this website collects
sections.body: The website serves static pages. It sets no cookies, loads no third-party fonts and runs no advertising or analytics scripts. If you pick a language with the language switch, that choice is kept in your browser's local storage, only so the site can show you that language.

sections.title: The proposal form
sections.body: If you send the proposal form, the name, email address, optional company name and message you type are used to answer you. The form is submitted to our own endpoint and forwarded to hello@sousadev.com.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected or ask for it to be deleted, by writing to hello@sousadev.com.

privacy.processorsPending: The hosting provider, the email delivery provider and the retention period are not fixed yet, so they are not named here. They will be named in this policy before launch.
